summary.business_type: Local cultural organisation / event series (Hamburg, Germany)
top_findings: 9 duplicate/legacy URLs live, self-canonical and in the sitemap
All 12 /angebot/ service pages orphaned (zero inbound internal links)
18 event URLs have non-reciprocal hreflang (DE/EN/AR not linked)
Hero image is a 180 KB JPEG with no dimensions, fetchpriority or alt
Event schema has no offers - Event rich results blocked
Placeholder meta descriptions ('Your Attractive Heading') on legacy pages
Homepage carries 3.47 MB of images across 61 files
quick_wins: 301 the 9 legacy duplicate URLs and remove from sitemap
Add offers to Event schema (unlocks event rich results)
Add services block to homepage - fixes 12 orphan pages
Convert hero image to WebP with width/height/fetchpriority
Create a 1200x630 OG image (current is a 639x219 logo)
not_measured: Core Web Vitals (PSI rate limit exceeded)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTPS with correct http->https and www->non-www 301s
robots.txt allows crawling and declares the sitemap index
Real 404 responses, server-rendered content, correct lang/dir

findings.title: 9 duplicate/legacy URLs live and self-canonical
findings.description: Legacy slugs (/2147-2/, /privacy-policy/, /festivalprogramm/, /kulturartikel/, /arab-kulturfestival-2/, /arabische-musik/, /arabische-musik-2/, /kalligrafie/, /kalligrafie-2/, /arabische-kultur-im-exil-2/) are indexable and in the sitemap.
findings.recommendation: 301 each to the current equivalent and remove from the sitemap.

findings.title: 19 orphan pages, 27 unreachable from home
findings.description: All 12 /angebot/ service pages have zero inbound internal links; /festivalprogramm/, /kulturartikel/, /newsletter/, /privacy-policy/, /2147-2/ and both category archives are also orphaned.
findings.recommendation: Add a services block to the homepage and /festival/; link /angebot/ from navigation or footer.

findings.title: Security headers missing
findings.description: No HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options or Referrer-Policy. X-Powered-By exposes PHP/8.4.27.
findings.recommendation: Add the five headers (CSP report-only first) and set expose_php = Off.

findings.title: 5 internal links redirect via /uncategorized/
findings.description: Menu/related-post links still point at the old category path.
findings.recommendation: Update templates to the final URLs.

findings.title: Category archives in the sitemap
findings.description: 2 category archives with no unique value are in category-sitemap.xml.
findings.recommendation: Exclude the category sitemap or noindex archives.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Homepage content quality 96/100, zero AI-pattern flags, zero filler
Real entity signals: address, phone, founder, social profiles
Specific venue, schedule and artist detail
Native Arabic copy, not machine translation

findings.title: 12 service pages are 55-74% near-duplicates
findings.description: All /angebot/* pages share hero, 'Was dich erwartet', 'Für wen' and CTA blocks; only the first paragraph differs.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite each to 700-1,000 words with unique instructor, schedule, price, venue, FAQ and photos.

findings.title: 9 duplicate/legacy article pairs dilute topical authority
findings.description: Duplicates include arabische-kultur-im-exil, arabische-musik, kalligrafie, festivalprogramm, kulturartikel, privacy-policy and 2147-2.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate with 301s and keep one canonical article per topic.

findings.title: Thin pages
findings.description: /newsletter/ 183 words, /kulturartikel/ 206, article indexes 312-327 with no intro; legal pages 277-298 are acceptable.
findings.recommendation: Merge or expand /newsletter/; add a 100-word intro to article indexes.

findings.title: E-E-A-T gaps
findings.description: Article author is the Organization; no author bios, no visible dateModified, no press citations, no foundingDate/nonprofitStatus.
findings.recommendation: Add Person authors with bios, show last-updated dates, cite press mentions, extend Organization schema.

findings.title: No Arabic webfont subset
findings.description: Only fraunces-normal-latin and work-sans-normal-latin are preloaded, so Arabic pages fall back to system fonts.
findings.recommendation: Add and preload an Arabic subset on lang=ar pages.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Titles on 91/91, descriptions on 88/91, canonicals on 91/91

findings.title: Placeholder and broken meta descriptions
findings.description: 'Your Attractive Heading' on /festivalprogramm/; auto-scraped body text on /kulturartikel/; 'datenschutz' on /privacy-policy/; 'Haftungsausschluss:' on /2147-2/.
findings.recommendation: 301 the legacy pages or write real 140-155 char descriptions.

findings.title: Duplicate H1s on two pages
findings.description: /arabische-kultur-im-exil-2/ has 'RechnungRechnung' plus the real title; /kulturartikel/ repeats 'Kulturartikel' twice.
findings.recommendation: Remove the leftover block and demote the duplicate heading to H2.

findings.title: 19 titles over 60 characters
findings.description: Worst are 179 and 108 chars on 2023 archive posts; 12 event titles are 62 chars.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite to ~55 chars, keep the date unique on events.

findings.title: 9 titles under 30 characters
findings.description: Includes 'Arab Kulturfestival' (19), 'Artikel -arab-kulturfestival' (28, malformed), and 6 EN pages at 27-29.
findings.recommendation: Add city or differentiator to each.

findings.title: 19 descriptions under 70 characters
findings.description: Shortest are 11, 19, 23, 35 and 39 chars.
findings.recommendation: Expand to 140-155 chars with a call to action.

findings.title: Duplicate titles and descriptions
findings.description: 2 duplicate title pairs (arabische-musik, kalligrafie) and 3 description groups covering 18 event URLs.
findings.recommendation: Differentiate with date/venue per event; 301 the duplicate service pages.

findings.title: OG image is a 639x219 logo
findings.description: Used with summary_large_image, which expects 1200x630. twitter:data1 exposes 'admin'.
findings.recommendation: Create 1200x630 OG images and remove the admin label.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: JSON-LD on 91/91 pages with zero parse errors
Organization includes address, phone, email, founder and sameAs
BreadcrumbList on 86, Article on 20, Event on 19

findings.title: No LocalBusiness/NGO markup
findings.description: A physical Hamburg cultural organisation has only generic Organization markup.
findings.recommendation: Add NGO + LocalBusiness with foundingDate, areaServed and nonprofitStatus.

findings.title: Event schema missing offers
findings.description: No offers, performer, isAccessibleForFree or eventSchedule; image is a theme placeholder. Event rich results are blocked.
findings.recommendation: Add offers with price, priceCurrency, availability and url.

findings.title: Article author is the Organization
findings.description: No Person author, no bio, no author URL.
findings.recommendation: Attribute posts to a named Person and add a visible byline.

findings.title: No Service schema on 12 service pages
findings.description: Bookable cultural services have no Service markup.
findings.recommendation: Add Service with provider, areaServed, serviceType and offers.

findings.title: No FAQPage markup
findings.description: Registration, price, venue and language questions are answered in prose only.
findings.recommendation: Add 3-5 Q&As per service page and event series with FAQPage schema.

findings.title: WebSite lacks SearchAction
findings.description: No potentialAction declared.
findings.recommendation: Add SearchAction if /?s= search is enabled.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: JS 55 KB and CSS 33 KB are modest

findings.title: Hero image is an unoptimised 180 KB JPEG
findings.description: hero-dabke.jpg has no width/height, no fetchpriority, empty alt and is likely the LCP element.
findings.recommendation: Convert to WebP ~1600px, add dimensions, fetchpriority=high and preload.

findings.title: 3.47 MB of images on the homepage
findings.description: 61 images, 45 gallery slides at 80-102 KB each, srcset stops at 1400px.
findings.recommendation: Add 480w/768w candidates, cap the gallery at 8-12 images, add content-visibility.

findings.title: TTFB borderline and HTML uncacheable
findings.description: 676 ms median on home, 524-637 ms inner pages; Cache-Control max-age=0 blocks all caching.
findings.recommendation: Enable page caching/CDN and set public, max-age=600, s-maxage=86400.

findings.title: 45 gallery slides in the initial DOM
findings.description: Inflates DOM and forces image decode during scroll.
findings.recommendation: Render 5 slides server-side and load the rest on interaction.

findings.title: No Arabic webfont on RTL pages
findings.description: FOUT and inconsistent metrics on Arabic pages.
findings.recommendation: Add an Arabic subset and preload it only on lang=ar pages.

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: https://arab-kulturfestival.de/llms.txt returns 404.
findings.recommendation: Publish llms.txt with programme, services, about and contact links.

findings.title: Weak citability
findings.description: No definition paragraph, no FAQ blocks, no visible dateModified, price/registration not stated early.
findings.recommendation: Add 40-60 word definition paragraphs and Q&A blocks to key pages.

findings.title: No Content-Signal declaration
findings.description: robots.txt does not declare AI training/input preferences.
findings.recommendation: Add Content-Signal with a deliberate policy.

findings.title: No Markdown delivery
findings.description: Agents requesting text/markdown receive HTML.
findings.recommendation: Optional: add .md variants or content negotiation.

findings.title: 184 images missing alt text (29.8%)
findings.description: Concentrated in 11 theme assets across 40 pages: hero-dabke, stage-group, calligraphy, music, community-circle and 6 SVG step diagrams.
findings.recommendation: Add descriptive alt to the 11 theme files; fixes ~120 instances.

findings.title: Wrong image on music pages
findings.description: calligraphy.jpg appears twice on /angebot/arabische-musik/ and its translations.
findings.recommendation: Replace with a concert photo.

findings.title: Gallery alt text is auto-numbered
findings.description: 45 images use 'Bilder vom Arab Kulturfestival - 34' style alt.
findings.recommendation: Describe subjects, or use empty alt if purely decorative.

findings.title: 274 images lack width/height
findings.description: 44% of images have no intrinsic dimensions, causing CLS risk.
findings.recommendation: Add width/height and CSS aspect-ratio backstops.

categories.name: International SEO (Hreflang)
what_works: 91/91 pages emit hreflang with self-reference and x-default

findings.title: 18 event URLs have non-reciprocal hreflang
findings.description: Each event translation declares only its own language (DE: de+x-default, EN: en, AR: ar).
findings.recommendation: Link the three URLs of each date in one translation group.

findings.title: 5 legacy pages point hreflang at the homepage
findings.description: /2147-2/, /festivalprogramm/, /kulturartikel/, /newsletter/, /privacy-policy/ declare /en/ and /ar/, which do not link back.
findings.recommendation: 301 the legacy pages or point at the real translated equivalents.

findings.title: Category archives declare listing pages as translations
findings.description: Both category archives point at /artikel/, /en/articles/, /ar/articles/, which do not link back.
findings.recommendation: Remove hreflang from category archives.

categories.name: Local SEO
what_works: NAP consistent across DE/EN/AR legal pages and schema
City in homepage title and H1

findings.title: No LocalBusiness schema
findings.description: No machine-readable local entity, so no knowledge panel or map pack feed.
findings.recommendation: Add NGO + LocalBusiness markup.

findings.title: No location landing pages
findings.description: Service pages target the activity but not Hamburg.
findings.recommendation: Add Hamburg to service H1/titles; build 3 location pages.

findings.title: Google Business Profile not linked
findings.description: No GBP URL in sameAs and no hasMap.
findings.recommendation: Create or claim GBP and link it.

findings.title: No map or directions on /kontakt/
findings.description: Address is present but no map embed, transit or parking note.
findings.recommendation: Add a map and 'So erreichst du uns'.

categories.name: Search Experience (SXO)
what_works: Homepage matches the brand + festival query well
Programme and events pages exist for date queries

findings.title: Service intent lands on expiring event pages
findings.description: 'Dabke Kurs Hamburg' resolves to dated instances while the durable /angebot/ page is thin and orphaned.
findings.recommendation: Build a Dabke hub page with all dates and link events to it.

findings.title: No conversion path on event pages
findings.description: Price, registration status and calendar CTA are not above the fold.
findings.recommendation: Add price, 'Keine Anmeldung nötig' and calendar/route CTAs above the fold.

findings.title: Homepage H1 is poetic, not entity-matching
findings.description: 'Wo arabische Kultur in Bewegung kommt' contains no entity or city.
findings.recommendation: Use 'Arabisches Kulturfestival Hamburg' as H1 and keep the line as a subheading.

findings.title: No FAQ blocks
findings.description: Registration, price, venue and language questions are answered only in prose.
findings.recommendation: Add 5-question FAQ blocks with FAQPage schema.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: 301 the 9 duplicate/legacy URLs and remove them from the sitemap
Fix event hreflang reciprocity for 6 dates x 3 languages
Add offers/performer to Event schema
Replace placeholder meta descriptions
Remove duplicate H1s on /arabische-kultur-im-exil-2/ and /kulturartikel/
Add a services block to the homepage to fix 12 orphans
Convert and preload the hero image as WebP with dimensions
Add alt text to the 11 theme image files

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Build the Dabke hub page with all upcoming dates
Expand the 12 service pages to 700-1,000 unique words
Add LocalBusiness/NGO schema
Add price and CTAs above the fold on event pages
Trim the homepage gallery to 8-12 images and add mobile srcset
Replace calligraphy.jpg on music pages
Fix the 5 /uncategorized/ internal redirects
Add security headers and remove X-Powered-By
Enable page caching and CDN
Create a 1200x630 OG image
Shorten 19 long titles and lengthen 9 short titles
Add an Arabic webfont subset

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Publish llms.txt
Add FAQ blocks with FAQPage schema
Add definition paragraphs to key pages
Add Person authors and visible bylines
Create location landing pages (Dabke/Musik/Kalligrafie Hamburg)
Create or link a Google Business Profile
Add map and directions to /kontakt/
Add Content-Signal to robots.txt
Add SearchAction to WebSite schema
Add participant testimonials

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Store the current crawl as a pre-fix baseline
Connect Search Console and submit the sitemap index
Retry PSI with an API key after image fixes
Set up seo-drift baselines before each deploy
Run monthly orphan/duplicate/alt/TTFB checks
